description: This script detects text bounding boxes and recognized text within a video, optionally using subtitles to adjust subtitle positioning based on detected on-screen text. It leverages OpenCV, EasyOCR, and pysubs2 to process video frames and subtitle files.

methods.name: List[np.ndarray] extract_frames(video_path: str, start_sec: float, end_sec: float, fps: int = 1)
methods.description: Extracts frames from a video file between specified start and end times at a given frame rate.

methods.name: List[dict] detect_text_boxes_with_easyocr(frames: List[np.ndarray], languages=['en'], gpu=False)
methods.description: Detects text and bounding boxes in a list of video frames using EasyOCR.

methods.name: detect_text_boxes_in_timeframe(video_path: str, start_sec: float, end_sec: float, fps: int = 1, languages=['en'], gpu=False)
methods.description: Extracts frames in a specified timeframe and detects text boxes within those frames.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int,int,int] default_subtitle_box(frame_width: int, frame_height: int, region: str = "bottom")
methods.description: Calculates a default subtitle region box in the frame, typically bottom 18%.

methods.name: List[int] get_frame_indices(start_ms: int, end_ms: int, fps: float, vid_total_frames: int, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Calculates frame indices to analyze within a subtitle cue based on timing and sampling rate.

methods.name: bool text_overlap_in_box(text_results: list, box: Tuple[int, int, int, int])
methods.description: Checks if any detected OCR text overlaps with a specified bounding box.

methods.name: process_subtitle_overlap( video_path: str, subs_path: str, output_path: str, sample_rate: int = 2, ocr_languages: Optional[List[str]] = None, gpu: bool = False, default_region: str = "bottom" )
methods.description: Processes subtitles to detect on-screen text overlap and adjusts subtitle position for better visibility.
